title: Why can't I create a split payment?
summary: This document explains why split payments can’t be created: the participant group exceeds 30 and/or the total amount exceeds $5,500. It also lists blockers like missing participant contact info, incomplete description/allocations that don’t reconcile to the total, and attempting to add the same participant more than once.
